title: Income Tax Act 2023 Section 313 – Tax VAT Point
main_content: Section 313 - Punishment for Fake Statement Proved subject to Verification If any person makes any such account or statement which is fake, and he knows or believes that it is fake or does not believe it to be true, he shall be liable to imprisonment for a term not exceeding 5 (five) years with fine, but not less than 6 (six) months shall be punished with imprisonment. In the event of a conflict between the information on this website and the original Government publications or notifications of laws, rules, regulations, and SROs, the Government publications or notifications shall prevail.
